newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SMH says strong growth continues in May.
newsitem.headline: SMH says strong growth continues in May.

text.p: Nicolas Hayek, president of Swiss watchmaker Ste Suisse Microelectronique et d'Horlogerie SA (SMH), said the strong growth in sales seen in the first four months of the year had continued during the month of May.
Earlier today Hayek told a news conference that SMH's sales in the first four months of this year were significantly higher than the same period last year, but he gave no figures.
Hayek also cautioned against excessively optimistic estimates for the entire year as around 48 percent of the turnover is achieved from September through December.
